object_description: Agent-designed modern pivot task lamp. Five visible structural parts planned from an AI-generated transparent reference image.

parts.label: lower circular base
parts.appearance: broad low cylindrical disk with rounded outer edges and a flat top, positioned horizontally beneath the upright stem on the left

parts.label: left upright stem
parts.appearance: long straight vertical cylindrical post of constant circular cross-section, rising from the center of the round base to the upper hinge

parts.label: upper circular hinge
parts.appearance: short thick cylindrical joint with a broad circular front face, centered on the top of the upright stem and joining the inclined arm

parts.label: upper right inclined arm
parts.appearance: short thick straight cylindrical rod rising diagonally to the right from the upper hinge to the narrow upper end of the lampshade

parts.label: upper right conical lampshade
parts.appearance: large hollow truncated-conical shell flaring downward to a broad circular open rim, with a short cylindrical neck at its narrow top, positioned at the right end of the inclined arm
